messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: drafting the internal announce + ops checklist for tomorrow's staged rollout. Planning a small early canary then stepped increase. Need final pin and rollback wording.
kevin: Sounds good. Which model variant are we pinning?
sophia: I can do a quick copy pass if you drop the draft here.
ryan: Ops rec: pin to inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.1-d (quantized low-mem). Rollback lane is immediate cut to v3.2.0 + KV prefix invalidation. Also prewarm KV shards in canary region.
maria: Draft below (short digest + checklist):
```
Internal release notice — compact
Schedule: 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC (change window)
Rollout: staged canary — 5% for 2h -> 25% for 1h -> 100% if all green
Model pin: inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.1-d
Rollback: revert to inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.0; flush KV prefix cache
Watchlist: p95 latency, token cost per request, prompt-eval hallucination metric
User impact: no UI changes, model behavior minor tokenizer adjustment (backwards-compatible)
Owners: Maria, Kevin, Ryan (oncall)
```

kevin: Nice. Add the deploy-bot cue and include an explicit smoke test step in the runbook. Also note thresholds: rollback if p95 +100ms or hallucination rate increases >10% on core prompt set.
sophia: Suggested short announce copy for staff digest: "Rolling inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.1-d on 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC with a staged rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Expect lower per-token cost on long inputs. Ops will monitor p95 latency, token cost, and prompt-eval regressions. Rollback is to v3.2.0 + KV cache flush. Standby: Maria / Kevin / Ryan."

maria: Perfect — I'll post that to the internal announce channel at T-30m. @deploy-bot can you schedule the canary and post cues to #eng-oncall and #eng-sre? Set canary timer 2h.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maria: canary start 2026-03-22T18:00:00Z, policy staged (5% -> 25% -> 100%), canary timeout 2h. Notifications: #eng-oncall, #eng-sre. Cancel: /deploy cancel 1779654321.
ryan: Ops checklist reminders: Kevin please prewarm KV shards; run smoke tests after canary kicks (50 short + 50 long requests). If we observe p95 +100ms or hallucination +10% -> rollback.
kevin: Prewarming KV now. Smoke test snippet for runbook: 
```
# post-canary smoke
for i in $(seq 1 50); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/gen -d '{"model":"inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.1-d","prompt":"short"}'; done
for i in $(seq 1 50); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/gen -d '{"model":"inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.1-d","prompt":"<~1k token long prompt>"}'; done
```

sophia: LGTM. I'll be on standby for the artifact that goes to the staff digest and the internal announce. Add :thumbsup: when ready.
maria: Final internal announce (one-paragraph): "Heads-up: We will roll inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.1-d on 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC using a staged rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Expected improvements: lower per-token cost for long inputs and stable p95 latency. No user-visible UI changes. Ops will monitor p95 latency, token cost, and prompt-eval regressions; rollback is revert to v3.2.0 + KV cache flush. Standby roster: Maria, Kevin, Ryan. See internal runbook for steps, smoke tests, and cancellation instructions"

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll attach dashboards and the quick query links to the announce thread before you post.
ryan: Ready for canary. If hallucination or latency breach thresholds, I'll trigger rollback immediately.
maria: Posting now and will update this thread with deploy-bot confirmations once the canary starts. Thanks everyone :rocket:
